race.title: Kevin McManus Bookmaker Handicap Chase
race.verdict: KARL DES TOURELLES wasn't scoring out of turn in this sphere when landing a Galway novice chase last time and remains well treated on his best hurdling form. He can follow up back in a handicap. Rockonliam is progressive and feared most, while both the unexposed On Your Way and consistent Watch The Weather are also respected. KARL DES TOURELLES (FR) ROCKONLIAM (IRE) ON YOUR WAY (IRE)
